title: payment.approved
description: Published by billing-service (RabbitMQ order.exchange) once PaymentService.processPayment resolves a charge to APPROVED. Consumed by orders-service's PaymentEventsConsumer, driving the state machine into PAYMENT_APPROVED. Same PaymentEvent class as payment.failed/payment.refunded/payment.refund.failed, but this routing key always carries transactionId and never failureReason -- a dedicated schema per routing key, not one shared for the class, so each guarantee is checked precisely.
